panels.general_description: Pink-grid 12-lead ECG print with three rows by four columns of lead labels.
panels.detailed_description: A scanned ECG on pink millimetre-grid paper with twelve lead windows in three rows by four columns. Printed labels read I, VR, V1, V4 in the top row, II, VL, V2, V5 in the middle row and III, VF, V3, V6 in the bottom row. A rectangular calibration pulse sits at the left start of each row. Each lead window holds only a few widely spaced complexes with low-amplitude deflections between them; V1 shows one tall narrow upward deflection and several leads show downward-pointing complexes. No numeric scale, rate or patient text is printed.
